# Town of Dummerston municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 7; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Dummerston Selectboard members: Todd Davidson (Chair), Paul Adler (Vice Chair), Maria Glabach, Theresa Chapman, and Alexander Lockie.

Town of Dummerston Selectboard minutes, March 4, 2026 (dummerston.org): the post-election reorganization minutes of March 4, 2026 seat Todd Davidson (Chair), Paul Adler (Vice Chair), Maria Glabach (Clerk), Terry Chapman, and Alex Lockie, welcoming Chapman and Lockie as new members. The town's pages print 'Terry Chapman' and 'Alex Lockie'; the directory prints Theresa Chapman and Alexander Lockie.
Town of Dummerston 'Town Meeting 2026: Annual Report for 2025' (dummerston.org): the ELECTED OFFICERS table lists Laurie Frechette as Town Clerk (1-year term).
Town of Dummerston Selectboard minutes, March 4, 2026 (dummerston.org): Laurie Frechette called the March 4, 2026 Selectboard meeting to order as Town Clerk.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Laurie Frechette as Town Clerk of Dummerston.
Town of Dummerston 'Town Meeting 2026: Annual Report for 2025' (dummerston.org): the ELECTED OFFICERS table lists Christopher Brown as Town Treasurer (1-year term).
Town of Dummerston official website (dummerston.org, current): the current Municipal Staff listing names Christopher Brown as Treasurer.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Christopher Brown as Town Treasurer of Dummerston.

Town of Dummerston 'Town Meeting 2026: Annual Report for 2025' (dummerston.org): the ELECTED OFFICERS table lists Cindy Jerome as Moderator (1-year term), and Article 2 of the 2026 Warning asked voters to affirm her election as Moderator despite her no longer being a resident. Structure only: no official source publishes the outcome of that article or names a current moderator; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Town of Dummerston 'Town Meeting 2026: Annual Report for 2025' (dummerston.org): the ELECTED OFFICERS table lists Charlotte Neer Annis (term expiring 2026), Michael Silberman (2027), and Stephan Mindel (2028) as Listers.

Town of Dummerston official website (dummerston.org, current): the current Municipal Staff listing names Mathew Leger as Lister alongside Silberman and Mindel. No published tally records the 2026 lister outcome; Leger is recorded as the current holder of the third seat on the town's listing, and Annis is not recorded.

Town of Dummerston 'Town Meeting 2026: Annual Report for 2025' (dummerston.org): the ELECTED OFFICERS table lists Ray Harris (term expiring 2026), Joe Little (2027), and Ruth Hoffman (2028) as Auditors.
Town of Dummerston official website (dummerston.org, current): the Town Clerk page names Ruth Hoffman, Joe Little, and Ray Harris as the current auditors.

Town of Dummerston 'Town Meeting 2026: Annual Report for 2025' (dummerston.org): the APPOINTED OFFICERS table lists Lewis White as First Constable: the office is appointive in Dummerston and appears on no election warning.

Town of Dummerston 'Town Meeting 2026: Annual Report for 2025' (dummerston.org): the APPOINTED OFFICERS table lists the Delinquent Tax Collector as Laurie Frechette (interim). Article 4 of the 2026 Warning asked voters to authorize the Selectboard to appoint a receiver of delinquent taxes; its outcome is not published. Frechette is recorded as the appointed holder per the town report.

Town of Dummerston 'Town Meeting 2026: Annual Report for 2025' (dummerston.org): the ELECTED OFFICERS table lists five town-elected Library Trustees (Lydia Taft Pratt Library) on 5-year terms: Marvin Luna (expiring 2026), David Schottland (2027), Lyle Holiday (2028), Linda DeCarlo Burns (2029), and Stacy Byrck (2030), and the 2026 Warning placed a 5-year Library Trustee seat on the ballot.

Town of Dummerston official website (dummerston.org, current): the library's current Board of Trustees page lists Lyle Holiday, Dave Schottland, Stacy Bryck, Linda DeCarlo Burns, and Kate Jansak. Luna's term expired in 2026 and he is not recorded; Jansak is recorded as the current holder of the seat that stood in 2026.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Dummerston justices of the peace: Paul Normandeau, Ruth Hoffman, Lew Sorenson, Linda Hellus, Betsy Bates, Elizabeth (Libby) Lafland, and Ezekiel Goodband.
Town of Dummerston 'Town Meeting 2026: Annual Report for 2025' (dummerston.org): the ELECTED OFFICERS table lists the same seven justices of the peace, elected November 2024.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Dummerston justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Paul Normandeau, Ruth Hoffman, Lew Sorenson, Linda Hellus, Betsy Bates, Elizabeth (Libby) Lafland, and Ezekiel Goodband. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded.
Town of Dummerston 'Town Meeting 2026: Annual Report for 2025' (dummerston.org): the ELECTED OFFICERS table lists the same seven justices of the peace.
